sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently 1st with 22 points, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00 in a fixture that should see the leaders extend their position. After a recent loss, Sandbach bounced back into winning ways and face one of the division's weakest sides—Alsager Town sit bottom with just 4 points from 10 games and are without a win in their last five matches. Sandbach then travel to Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday 10 October, also at 15:00, where they'll face another struggling opponent currently on a poor run.
divisionWide: The title race remains competitive as second-placed Stafford Town (20 points) host fellow promotion contenders: they face Wednesfield Community on 10 October, while Wednesfield visit Brereton Social in a midweek clash on 7 October. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, are away at Eccleshall on 3 October in a potentially tight encounter. Wolverhampton Casuals (19 points) have good momentum and welcome Wednesfield Community on 3 October. The bottom half shows several struggling teams: Widnes Town, without a win all season, travel to Brereton Social on 3 October; Telford Town visit Cheadle Heath Nomads and later host New Mills; Alsager Town play Sandbach and then Shawbury United; and Cheadle Heath Nomads are away at Sandbach before hosting Telford. Shawbury United, on a six-game losing streak, face Barnton away on 10 October. Brereton Social host Widnes (3 Oct) and Wednesfield (7 Oct) in close succession, while Allscott Heath welcome Sandbach on 10 October. Other midtable fixtures include Crewe at home to Allscott Heath (3 Oct) and away to Bilston Town (10 Oct); Bilston Town host Foley Meir (3 Oct) and Crewe (10 Oct); Foley Meir visit Bilston; Market Drayton Town host New Mills (3 Oct) and Widnes Town (10 Oct); New Mills visit Market Drayton and then Telford; Barnton host Dawley Town (10 Oct); Dawley Town visit Barnton; and Sandbach face Cheadle Heath Nomads (10 Oct).
